desc: points lists the winner of each point of one tennis game in order, one character per point: "A" or "B". Return the score after all points. Point counts 0, 1, 2, 3 are called love, 15, 30, 40. A player wins the game on reaching at least 4 points with a lead of at least 2: return "game A" or "game B". Otherwise, if both have at least 3 points: equal is "deuce" and a one-point lead is "advantage A" or "advantage B". Otherwise equal counts give the name followed by "-all" (e.g. "love-all", "30-all"), and different counts give A's name, "-", B's name (e.g. "15-love", "30-40"). Read the characters left to right: a character that is neither "A" nor "B" gives "error: bad point", and any character after the game has been won gives "error: point after game"; the first of these met wins.
